jobs.title: Data Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
**About the Company**
---------------------

Valon is the leading AI platform for mortgage servicing, building the AI-native operating system for regulated finance.

Before providing the system of record that powers the entire industry, we built and ran our own mortgage servicer on it. That gave us a real regulated environment to prove our technology could replace the mainframe systems servicers have used for decades. Carrington acquired that servicer and adopted ValonOS as its core platform, allowing us to focus entirely on scaling our SaaS platform.

ValonOS is now on track to power 1 in 6 U.S. mortgages across major mortgage servicers like Newrez, Carrington, and ServiceMac. Every process on the platform is structured and programmable, enabling our AI agents to perform core servicing work, like handling payments, escrow, and homeowner questions, directly within the system's controls.

We recently raised a $150 million Series D at a $2.3 billion valuation by new investor Ribbit Capital, with continued support from existing backer a16z, amongst others.

**About the Role**
------------------

Valon is rebuilding the mortgage servicing industry from the ground up. We're looking for a **Data Implementation Manager** to join our team and help us coordinate and launch complex data deployment workstreams that will revolutionize how mortgage servicers operate.

In this role, you'll be instrumental in coordinating efforts across multiple teams (data, deployment strategy, engineering, product), ensuring seamless communication, and driving the successful delivery of our most critical initiatives.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* **Lead End-to-End Data Migration:** Work directly with clients to make sure their data is properly migrated and transformed for successful deployment.
* **Drive Cross-Functional Coordination:** Facilitate effective communication and collaboration between data, deployment strategy, engineering, product, and other stakeholders to ensure alignment and shared understanding.
* **Optimize Development Processes:** Identify and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency, predictability, and quality across the development lifecycle.
* **Manage Stakeholder Expectations:** Proactively communicate program status, risks, and dependencies to all relevant stakeholders, ensuring transparency and alignment.
* **Mitigate Risks and Resolve Issues:** Identify potential roadblocks and actively work to resolve technical, operational, and organizational challenges that may impact program delivery.
* **Define and Track Metrics:** Establish clear success metrics for programs and regularly track progress, providing data-driven insights to inform decision-making.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* **5+ years of experience** as an Implementation Manager, Customer Success Manager, or PM in a fast-paced, complex software development environment.
* **Proven track record** of successfully delivering large-scale, cross-functional technical programs.
* **Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC)** and various agile methodologies.
* **Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills**, with the ability to influence and align diverse stakeholders.
* **Excellent problem-solving abilities** and a proactive approach to identifying and mitigating risks.
* **Ability to thrive in a dynamic, rapidly evolving startup environment.**
* **Prior experience in fintech team is a plus, but not required.**

**Benefits**
------------

* **Compensation:** competitive salary with a meaningful stake in the company via equity, and 401(k) plan. The base salary range reflects multiple levels. We assess level based on a combination of experience and interview performance.
* **Health & well-being:** we’ll invest in your physical and mental well-being with comprehensive medical, dental, & vision benefits.
* **Free Food:** daily lunch, and dinner provided through Forkable for in-office team members.
* **Commuter benefits:** pre-tax deductions for public transit, rideshares, and parking to simplify your daily commute.
* **Grow together:** company wide orientation for you to successfully onboard and other learning & development opportunities including regular review cycles that feature 360-degree feedback.
* **Play together:** quarterly budgets for team and company outings. Use it for team swag, cooking classes, or team dinners.
* **Generous time off:** flexible paid time off with no annual limit, sick days, and 11 company holidays.
* **Baby bonding time:** 12 weeks of fully paid leave for both birthing and non-birthing parents, so you can spend uninterrupted time welcoming and caring for your newest family member.

*Throughout the interview process, please remember that emails will only be from* *valon.com* *email addresses. We will never ask for any personally identifiable information during the interview process itself. Please reach out to talent@valon.com if you have any requests to verify the authenticity of an outreach.*

*Valon is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. Valon makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.*

Compensation Range: $155K - $185K

**Job Type:** Full-Time / Part-Time  
**Compensation:** $28.00 – $35.00 per hour (based on experience)  
**Schedule:** Monday–Friday (8:00 AM – 6:00 PM), with occasional evenings/weekends as needed

* Support schedule adjustments, coverage, and staffing coordination
* Ensure compliance with payer, Medicaid, and ACP documentation standards

* Bachelor’s degree in Psychology, Education, ABA, or related field
* Minimum **2 years of ABA or behavior intervention experience**
* Experience working with children with autism or developmental disabilities
* Ability to supervise, coach, and support clinical staff
* Reliable transportation and willingness to travel between locations if needed

**Required Certifications (or willingness to obtain)**

* **RBT Certification (preferred or must obtain within 60 days)**
* CPR & First Aid Certification
* Negative TB test (within required timeframe)
* Background check clearance

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in a supervisory or lead RBT role
* Bilingual (Spanish preferred)
* Experience with CentralReach or similar EMR systems
* Currently pursuing BCBA certification (highly preferred)

* Competitive hourly rate: **$28–$34/hour**
* Bonus opportunities tied to performance and billable targets
* Health, Dental, Vision benefits (for eligible employees)
* Mileage reimbursement (if applicable)
* Paid training and professional development
* **Supervision hours available toward BCBA certification**

At BB Care, we are committed to delivering **high-quality, ethical, and compassionate ABA services**. We foster a collaborative environment where clinicians are supported, developed, and empowered to grow in their careers.

You will be part of a **mission-driven team** focused on meaningful outcomes for children and families.

This role serves as a pathway toward:

* Senior Clinical Leadership
* Assistant Clinical Director
* BCBA Certification and Clinical Advancement

* Ability to perform job duties in a clinical setting, including movement and interaction with clients
* Maintain professional conduct, confidentiality, and ethical standards at all times

jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience in program or project management.
* Experience with planning or forecasting for data center infrastructure or supply chain (e.g., resource management, capacity planning, inventory planning, demand forecasting).
* Experience managing programs and processes across distributed systems.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 2 years of experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects.
* Experience in product area resource management/infrastructure planning roles.
* Domain expertise in more than one of these areas: data center infrastructure (compute/storage/networking), capacity planning, demand forecasting, supply chain planning, ML (TPU/GPU) infrastructure.
* Technical aptitude and familiarity/experience with programming (e.g., SQL, AI vibe coding).

**About the job**
-----------------

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.

The Commerce Product Area (PA) is a division within Google's Knowledge and Information (K&I) organization. Its mission is to deliver delightful, trusted, and seamless commercial connections for everyone. They are responsible for managing machine resources, associated budgets, and distributions for the Commerce Product Area.

As part of Commerce Resource Management, you will be working in a dynamic environment, balancing the allocation of finite data center resources to best fit business needs. You will be a primary point-of-contact for forecasting, planning, and allocation of capacity needs across Commerce to ensure that proper financial accountability yields successful launches and growth for our products.

Google Ads is at the forefront of AI innovation, applying cutting-edge machine learning and Generative AI models like Gemini to power a multi-billion dollar global business.

Our work directly impacts billions of users by protecting users from harm, improving ad quality, and optimizing campaigns for advertiser return-on-investment. We foster a culture of deep collaboration, partnering closely with teams like Google Research and DeepMind to solve complex challenges. Join us to work on state-of-the-art AI, take on problems at an unparalleled scale, and build the next generation of advertising technology.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $132000 - $189000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Oversee annual budget planning, quarterly resource ordering, and OpEx tracking for compute, storage, and specialized artificial intelligence and machine learning hardware.
* Process, validate, and deliver resource requests to engineering teams.
* Drive resource efficiency efforts, including clawbacks of unneeded resources, to ensure high utilization and cost savings.
* Coordinate closely with other resource pools and Product Area Resource Management teams, particularly Ads Resource Engineering, Core, and Search, to acquire and distribute resources.
* Build tooling and leverage AI to automate and simplify resource management processes.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. jobs.title: Medical Receptionist / Patient Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
*New to healthcare or returning to work after time spent raising a family or caregiving? We welcome your application.*

Peninsula Integrative Medicine is an established integrative medicine clinic seeking a warm, dependable, organized person to help patients feel welcome and keep our front office running smoothly.

**Medical office experience is helpful, but not required.** We provide paid training in our systems and workflows. We’re looking for someone who communicates thoughtfully, pays attention to details, and follows through on responsibilities.

Your experience may come from healthcare, another industry, raising a family, caregiving, or volunteering. We’re interested in the skills and perspective you would bring to supporting our patients and team.

**Schedule**

This position works **Monday–Friday, 8:30 a.m.–5:30 p.m., in person at our Palo Alto clinic**, with no nights or weekends.

Consistent attendance and availability for the full schedule are essential because our patients and team rely on front office coverage throughout the day.

**What You’ll Do**

With training and support, you’ll learn to:

**Welcome and support patients**

* Greet patients and create a calm, welcoming front office.
* Answer phones and respond to patient messages through our electronic medical records system.
* Schedule appointments, manage check-in and check-out, and help patients understand their next administrative steps.
* Explain our clinic’s services and direct medical questions to the appropriate clinician.
* Process payments for visits and products.

**Keep details organized and tasks moving**

* Track calls, messages, and follow-up tasks through completion.
* Keep patient records organized, including uploading documents and preparing administrative materials for appointments.
* Help stock and track supplements and office supplies.

**Provide administrative support to our doctors**

* Review and route patient messages according to clinic protocols.
* Assist with referrals, prior authorization paperwork, and communication with labs and pharmacies.
* Complete administrative follow-up tasks as directed.

**What We’re Looking For**

* **Warmth and professionalism:** You enjoy helping people and communicate with patience and respect.
* **Dependability:** You arrive on time, communicate proactively, and follow through on commitments.
* **Organization:** You can keep track of details and manage several tasks, asking for help when priorities are unclear.
* **Willingness to learn:** You’re comfortable using a computer and learning new software. We’ll train you on our clinic systems.
* **Teamwork:** You welcome feedback, help colleagues, and share ideas for making things work better.
* **Interest in a long-term role:** You’re looking for a place to learn, contribute, and grow.

No previous medical office experience is required. Experience in customer service, hospitality, administration, caregiving, or volunteering is welcome. Interest in integrative medicine is a plus.

High school diploma or equivalent required.

**What We Offer**

* Paid training and support as you learn the role.
* A consistent weekday schedule with no nights or weekends.
* Health, dental, and vision insurance.
* 401(k) with employer matching.
* Paid time off, paid sick time, and paid holidays.
* Employee discounts.
* Professional development assistance.
* Opportunities to learn about integrative medicine, supplements, and functional medicine testing.
* A respectful, supportive team where your questions, ideas, and suggestions are welcome.

**How to Apply**

Please submit your **resume and a brief introduction** answering these two questions. A few sentences for each is plenty:

* What interests you about this position at Peninsula Integrative Medicine?
* Tell us about a time others relied on you to keep things organized or follow through on an important responsibility. Your example can come from paid work, caregiving, volunteering, or another part of your life.

Please also confirm that you are available to work **in person, Monday–Friday, 8:30 a.m.–5:30 p.m.**

**Changing careers or returning to paid work?** You do not need a traditional medical office background to apply. We value the skills, care, and reliability you would bring to our team.

Pay: $25.00 - $30.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* On-the-job training
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Paid training
* Vision insurance

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager I
jobs.description:
### **The Role**

You'll partner with plaintiff U.S. law firms, from small and mid-market practices to select enterprise accounts, to drive software adoption, retention, and account growth. In this role, you'll act as a strategic advisor and change management partner, helping legal teams transform their workflows and leverage our platform—including generative AI capabilities—to achieve meaningful business outcomes on their most critical matters.

**This is a full-time, exempt position based in our New York City, NY or Oakland, CA office with a hybrid work schedule: in office M/W/Th with the option to work from home on Tu/Fr.**

What you'll do

* Own retention and growth across your book of business, driving renewals and identifying opportunities to expand usage
* Build multi-threaded relationships across law firm stakeholders, including day-to-day users, administrators, practice group leaders, and executive sponsors.
* Conduct regular check-in calls, strategic success reviews, and product demonstrations centered on usage data, business impact, and strategic alignment.
* Teach customers how to use platform features and workflows effectively, guiding them on best practices for adopting generative AI capabilities.
* Proactively identify retention risks, solve complex workflow challenges, and partner closely with Sales, User Education, Product, and Support to deliver a seamless customer experience.
* Share customer feedback, document best practices, and contribute to the continuous improvement of the Customer Success team.

About You

* You have at least 4 years of customer success experience managing a large book of mid-market and enterprise accounts within SaaS or consumption-based technology companies.
* You act as a strategic advisor and change management partner, using workflow expertise and data-driven account plans to influence customer behavior and drive adoption.
* You navigate complex client organizations effectively, building credibility, trust, and strong executive presence with senior leadership.
* You manage competing priorities proactively and possess exceptional written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
* You are authorized to work in the United States. Please note that at this time, Everlaw is not sponsoring U.S. employment visas for this role.

Bonus points

* Experience in legal tech, litigation software consulting, or related legal industry workflows.
* Experience working with AI tools (Claude, Glean, etc.) to optimize your day-to-day responsibilities

Think you're missing some of the skills and are hesitant to apply? We do not believe in the 'perfect' candidate and encourage you to apply if you feel you can bring value to our team. We often revisit candidates who may have applied for a different role if something comes up that's a better fit.

### **The Team — Customer Success**

The Customer Success team helps customers turn Everlaw's powerful technology into meaningful outcomes on their most important matters. As trusted advisors, the team builds lasting partnerships, guides adoption, and helps organizations integrate Everlaw into the way they work. By connecting customer priorities and feedback with teams across Everlaw, Customer Success helps customers realize sustained value while strengthening the relationships that drive retention and growth.

### **Total Rewards & Benefits**

The annual base salary for this position is between $116,000 - $148,000, with a total On-Target Earnings (OTE) of between $145,000 - $185,000, representing a 80/20 compensation split. Eligibility for the commission portion is performance-based and subject to the achievement of specific performance metrics, which are governed by Everlaw's policies and incentive plans. The final offered salary will be dependent upon many factors including the candidate's experience and skills. The role's compensation is subject to change in the future.

Health & well-being

* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Flexible Spending Accounts for health and dependent care expenses
* Membership to Modern Health to support mental health and wellness
* Paid parental leave
* Company-sponsored life and disability insurance

Financial rewards

* Competitive equity grants, so you share in Everlaw's long-term growth
* 401(k) plan with company matching of up to 4% of eligible annual compensation

Growth & everyday perks

* 17 paid vacation days, 11 federal holidays, and paid sick leave
* Four "Everlawlidays" (additional paid company-wide days off) per year
* Annual allocation for learning & development and relevant professional membership dues
* Hybrid work with regular work-from-home days and flexibility for life's logistics
* Monthly home internet reimbursement, plus a stipend for your desk setup
* Catered lunch each workday, plus snacks and company-wide events in our offices

About Everlaw When a lawsuit or investigation happens, teams must comb through vast amounts of electronic evidence — emails, documents, chats, files — to find what matters. That work is not a side task but the case itself, and where most of the time and money in litigation goes. Everlaw is the litigation and investigation management platform changing that, using AI to turn mountains of messy data into the handful of facts that win or lose a case, compressing weeks of work into hours.

We're the kind of place that's ranked #1 on G2 in our category and named a Great Place to Work™ by our own team. So if you want a front row seat to an industry in transformation, career-defining work you'll be proud to tell people about, and real upside at a company in control of its own destiny, we'd love to get to know you.

* #LI-KV1
* #LI-Hybrid

About Everlaw

*At Everlaw, you'll shape how AI re-wires the legal industry, at a category-leading business built on a mission to illuminate the truth.*

Everlaw is an equal opportunity employer. We pride ourselves on having a diverse workforce and we do not discriminate against any employee

**Summary of Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

Transition Phase (usually 90-120 days)

While permanent staff are being hired and onboarded, this position will serve as a member of the QuickStart Team to immediately begin work for the new CBL client.

At the immediate startup of a CBL, the CBL Project Manager will triage the incoming work to determine whether the instrument will be calibrated at the CBL, sent to another Transcat lab, or sent to an approved supplier. They will also perform calibrations through direct calibration of the instruments at the CBL or by performing the review of vendor calibration certs to complete those work orders. Steady-State Phase

Once the CBL reaches Steady-State, the Project Manager will perform data reviews of technicians’ work across multiple CBLs, remotely, to assist the Calibration Operations Managers with that supervisory function.

In addition, during the Steady-State phase, the Project Manager will move on to the next CBL startup (a Transition Phase at a new CBL), while still performing data reviews of the technicians’ work across multiple CBLs. As an integral member of the Client-Based Laboratory (CBL) infrastructure, the CBL Project Manager manages the building of the CBL business anywhere they are needed. More specifically, the CBL Project Manager will travel to new CBL sites to manage and support the management of the CBLs through the Transition and Steady-State phases. With an estimated 90-120 day period for each Transition phase, the CBL Project Manager can expect to be assigned to approximately three to four CBLs per year, depending upon the unique challenges and complexity of each CBL

Responsibilities:

**Summary of Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

Transition Phase (usually 90-120 days)

While permanent staff are being hired and onboarded, this position will serve as a member of the QuickStart Team to immediately begin work for the new CBL client.

At the immediate startup of a CBL, the CBL Project Manager will triage the incoming work to determine whether the instrument will be calibrated at the CBL, sent to another Transcat lab, or sent to an approved supplier. They will also perform calibrations through direct calibration of the instruments at the CBL or by performing the review of vendor calibration certs to complete those work orders. As the permanent technician(s) for the CBL are hired, onboarded, and ramp up their calibration duties, the CBL Project Managers will ramp down their direct calibration work and start training and supervising the permanent calibration technicians’ work. Over the course of each Transition Phase, the Project Manager’s calibration tasks start at 100% of their time and reduce to less than 10% over the Phase. In any given year, the calibration tasks equate to about one-third of a Project Manager’s time.

Steady-State Phase

Once the CBL reaches Steady-State, the Project Manager will perform data reviews of technicians’ work across multiple CBLs, remotely, to assist the Calibration Operations Managers with that supervisory function.

In addition, during the Steady-State phase, the Project Manager will move on to the next CBL startup (a Transition Phase at a new CBL), while still performing data reviews of the technicians’ work across multiple CBLs. In addition, whenever technician turnover occurs at a CBL, the Project Manager will also fill in to complete the calibration work, ramping down as the replacement technician is hired/onboarded as described above.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Plan and controlling workflow to meet customer demands
* Provide ongoing technical assistance and direction to staff relative to Company’s services
* Establishing and maintaining positive customer and employee relations
* Establishing and maintaining teamwork within laboratory
* Assist in managing the handling of customer and/or employee issues
* Triage incoming equipment and assign work to technicians in the laboratory
* Track availability and updates records of lab assets
* Oversee, delegate, and/or initiate requests for data sheets for units for which a data sheet does not currently exist
* Assist CBL Operations Manager with training/onboarding of permanent CBL technician(s)
* Utilize various computerized maintenance management software (CMMS) and databases for instrument identification, calibration data entry and asset management
* Apply general knowledge and experience of instruments that measure: temperature, pressure, flow, force, torque, chemical analysis, optics, humidity, speed, viscosity, mechanical dimensions, geometric dimensioning & tolerancing (GD&T), vacuum, light intensity, mass, voltage, current, resistance and frequency
* Adapt to learn new instruments, calibration techniques, and develop skills to support requirements, including training of technicians
* As needed, perform calibration of electronic, electro-mechanical, analytical and mechanical instrumentation across a multitude of Metrology disciplines which may include but are not limited to:
  + Autoclaves, DI water systems, Lyophilizers and Wave Bioreactors
  + Analytical balances, centrifuges, freezers, refrigerators, stability chambers, incubators, ovens, ph meters, conductivity meters, monitoring systems, timers, stopwatches, thermometers, and glass washers, et.al.
  + Process controlled instruments in a factory/production environment using an understanding of the overall process, to identify key instruments, process tolerances, safety considerations, timelines and production schedules.
  + Electronic instruments using high-end standards: Multifunction calibrators, SPRT/RTDs, temperature baths, dry blocks, oscilloscopes, power supplies, multimeters, function generators, HiPot testers, timers
  + Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing (GD&T): Custom gages using open-table setup, CMM, or Vision Sy
